svg.title: AI model training and inference workflow in pathology
svg.desc: Two-row flowchart: training phase (tissue slides, preprocessing, annotation, model training) connected by a dashed amber arrow to a trained model node in the inference row below (new slide, preprocessing, trained model, prediction).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are tissue slides prepared for computational pathology AI training?')
sendPrompt('How is preprocessing done in computational pathology, including tiling and stain normalization?')
sendPrompt('How do pathologists annotate slides to create training labels for AI models?')
sendPrompt('How are deep learning models trained and validated on pathology image data?')
sendPrompt('How is a new clinical biopsy digitized and prepared for AI inference?')
sendPrompt('Why must inference use the same preprocessing pipeline as training in pathology AI?')
sendPrompt('How does a trained pathology AI model run inference on new whole slide images?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of clinical predictions can AI models make from pathology slides?')
